recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎全為造血細胞、脂肪極少，紅血球系、顆粒球系增生並散在許多大小不一、分布較鬆散的巨核細胞，竇腔充滿紅血球；三系增生（panmyelosis）而無明顯纖維化，符合真性紅血球增多症。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absent fat
Panmyelosis with expanded erythroid and granulocytic precursors
Increased, pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size, scattered and loosely clustered, some with hyperlobated nuclei
Congested sinusoids filled with red cells
No obvious fibrosis, osteosclerosis or blast sheets
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hyperplasia. Megakaryocytes are increased and pleomorphic, ranging from small to large forms with hyperlobated nuclei, and are distributed singly and in loose clusters. Sinusoids are dilated and congested. No sheets of blasts or overt fibrosis are seen on H&E. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with panmyelosis, compatible with polycythemia vera, polycythemic phase.

ddx.vs: Features normocellular marrow with predominantly large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes and no significant erythroid or granulocytic proliferation.
Megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei in dense clusters, with granulocytic proliferation and reduced erythropoiesis.
Shows granulocytic predominance with small hypolobated (dwarf) megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
